answer: Stop sybils by binding each identity to one verified payment instrument: a real card or bank account no other agent may share. To join, an agent (1) registers its key, (2) binds a unique card and passes a $1 micro-charge check, (3) locks a 35 POA bond, and (4) loses bond and card if fraud is proven. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 real accounts at $50 each plus KYC — about $500,000 and 90 days — while one honest agent pays $1. Like an oasis the tide reaches only after real desert, the fable of cheap fakes dries up when every agent shows its one real card.
